items.title: Israel carries out air strikes on Lebanon, state media says, as Iran claims deal with US near
items.description: The strikes come as Iran's foreign minister says a deal to end fighting with the US is close.

items.title: Switzerland to vote on plan to cap population at 10 million
items.description: The right-wing Swiss People's Party calls the plan a "sustainability initiative",  but opponents say it is a recipe for chaos.

items.title: Married at First Sight Australia stars not told partners had drug and violence convictions
items.description: Stars of the hit TV show say they did not know their on-screen husbands had previous convictions.

items.title: Elon Musk becomes world's first trillionaire as SpaceX soars in stock market debut
items.description: Musk is now worth $1.11tn according to the Bloomberg rich list, while SpaceX listed on the Nasdaq stock exchange with a value of $2.2tn.

items.title: Fans on concourses instead of in seats, claims Fifa
items.description: Fifa says numerous empty seats were visible in the near-sell-out Group A match between South Korea and the Czech Republic because of fans remaining on concourses.

items.title: US kills leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang in airstrike, Trump says
items.description: Niño Guerrero was killed in a "swift and lethal kinetic strike," the US President wrote in a social media post.

items.title: Anthropic suspends new AI tools over US government security concerns
items.description: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5, released publicly this week, sparked concerns about cybersecurity and hacking.
